turns.question: It's the end of 5 October 2026 and our fiscal year starts on 1 February. What has our average daily revenue been so far this fiscal quarter, counting days with no orders as zero and leaving cancelled orders out?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric, so I can't give a per-day average; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) (revenue_eur, which already leaves cancelled orders out), Revenue month to date (EUR) and Average order value (EUR). Revenue (EUR) for this fiscal quarter so far (fiscal Q3, 1 August to 5 October 2026) was 19,573.59 EUR. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
